---
title: "Patch main figure — scatter & peak plots (panels A–H)"
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

## Introduction

Compose 8 panels of scatter and peak plots into a standalone multi-panel Figure. Panels A–D are scatter plots (VAE rank 1–2, UMAP rank 1–2) and panels E–H are peak plots (VAE rank 1–2, UMAP rank 1–2), all at threshold 8.

## Load the data

```{r}

scatter_a <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/scatter_rank01.rds")
)
scatter_b <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/scatter_rank02.rds")
)
scatter_c <- read_rds(
  here("UMAP/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/scatter_rank01.rds")
)
scatter_d <- read_rds(
  here("UMAP/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/scatter_rank02.rds")
)

peak_e <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/peak_rank01.rds")
)
peak_f <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/peak_rank02.rds")

peak_g <- read_rds(
  here("UMAP/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold8/peak_rank01.rds")
```

## Create a theme for the figure

```{r}
source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Compose the scatter & peak figure

### Relabel the colour key

The scatter plots carry the key "Dementia Status: Demented / Stable Normal" from `custom_func/make_faceted_scatter_and_contour_plot.R`, which codes every non-reference group "demented", including the two MCI groups. The key is relabelled here to "Group: Stable normal (reference) / Comparison group" (reviewer point R1.7); the colours are reused from the existing scale, so only the text changes.

```{r}
#| label: relabel-group-key

relabel_group_key <- function(plot) {
  key_colours <- plot$scales$get_scales("colour")$palette(2)
  stopifnot(setequal(names(key_colours), c("stable_normal", "demented")))
  # Replacing the existing colour scale is intended; silence ggplot's notice
  suppressMessages(
    plot +
      scale_color_manual(
        name = "Group",
        values = key_colours,
        labels = c(stable_normal = "Stable normal (reference)", demented = "Comparison group")
      )
  )
}
```

### Modify ggplot2 objects

```{r}

# Scatter plots (panels A–D)
scatter_main <- lst(
  a = scatter_a,
  b = scatter_b,
  c = scatter_c,
  d = scatter_d
) |>
  map(~ relabel_group_key(.x) + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  ))

scatter_main$a <- scatter_main$a +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
  )

# Rescale geom sizes for publication column width (18" → 6.5")
scatter_main <- scatter_main |>
  map(~ rescale_layer_params(.x, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5))

# Peak plots (panels E–H)
peak_main <- lst(
  e = peak_e,
  f = peak_f,
  g = peak_g,
  h = peak_h
) |>
  map(~ .x + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  ))

# Rescale peak geom sizes (6" → ~1.6" per panel, heavier scaling)
peak_main <- peak_main |>
  map(~ rescale_layer_params(.x, size_scale = 0.35, linewidth_scale = 0.35))

```

### Create row label strips

```{r}
make_row_label <- function(label) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = "grey90") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = label, angle = 270, size = 2.5) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
}

label_i <- make_row_label("VAE Rank 1")
label_j <- make_row_label("VAE Rank 2")
label_k <- make_row_label("UMAP Rank 1")
label_l <- make_row_label("UMAP Rank 2")
```

### Compose with patchwork

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-peak
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 17
#| fig-cap: "Scatter and peak plots"

layout <- "
AAAAAAAAAAAAI
BBBBBBBBBBBBJ
CCCCCCCCCCCCK
DDDDDDDDDDDDL
EEEFFFGGGHHH#
"

fig_scatter_peak <-
  scatter_main$a +
  scatter_main$b +
  scatter_main$c +
  scatter_main$d +
  peak_main$e +
  peak_main$f +
  peak_main$g +
  peak_main$h +
  label_i + label_j + label_k + label_l +
  plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "auto", axes = "keep", axis_titles = "keep") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# Suppress tags on label panels (panels 9–12)
for (i in 9:12) {
  fig_scatter_peak[[i]] <- fig_scatter_peak[[i]] +
    theme(plot.tag = element_blank())
}

fig_scatter_peak

fs::dir_create(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"))
png(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_scatter_peak.png"),
    width = 6.5, height = 9, units = "in", res = 600)
fig_scatter_peak
dev.off()
```
